description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between B. M. Basnayake and other part Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd. Pelawatta - Industrial Dispute between Flight Attendents Union and Sri Lanka Airlines Limited
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders and statements under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It includes statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act) and legal procedures for dispute resolution through arbitration, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
